+---

+position_ordinal: '8680'
+title: Remove the .timeLimit traits and the wall-clock waits from the Agents tests
+---
+## Item found in T1
+
+The Agents tests have 144 `.timeLimit` traits in 41 files (Tests and IntegrationTests/Tests), and about 13 uses of sleep or clock waits. The test rules of the user say: no .timeLimit, no sleep, no clock wait, no poll, no retry. A test that fails only sometimes is a bad test: make it deterministic (fixed order with gates or events), or fix the race in the code.
+
+## Work
+
+- Remove each `.timeLimit` trait (Router did the same in bafa9774).
+- Replace each sleep or clock wait with a wait on an event or a gate.
+- Run the full suite one time.
+
+The place in the order of step 3 is not decided yet. Asked in the T1 report. #mail-step-3
\ No newline at end of file
